name: Mechanical TRIZ
description: Same TRIZ machinery with mechanical / hardware vocabulary — moving parts, loads, wear, thermal and structural constraints.

parameter_map.Weight of moving object: mass / moment of inertia of the moving part
parameter_map.Speed: rotational speed (RPM) / linear velocity of the mechanism
parameter_map.Temperature: operating temperature / thermal load on the joint
parameter_map.Stability of the object's composition: vibration / resonance stability of the mechanism

principle_soft.1: modular / segmented tooling; split a large casting into bolted parts
principle_soft.2: take the failure-prone part out of the critical path (move a seal outside the wear zone)
principle_soft.3: local hardening — reinforce exactly where stress concentrates
principle_soft.5: combine fixtures; multi-material parts (steel core, plastic sleeve)
principle_soft.10: pre-load, pre-stress, pre-treat surfaces before service
principle_soft.15: dynamic stiffness; adaptive damping that stiffens under load
principle_soft.24: intermediary bushing / bearing / wear sleeve that absorbs the wear
principle_soft.35: change material state — surface treatment, heat treatment, coating

examples: A gearbox must transmit more torque but the housing cannot grow heavier or larger.
The spindle vibrates at high RPM; damping it rigidly would add too much mass.
